newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus police arrest granny on drugs charge.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus police arrest granny on drugs charge.

text.p: A 77-year-old Cypriot woman was arrested on arrival in Cyprus on Tuesday for illegally possessing 244 grammes of hashish.
Police said the woman was arrested at Larnaca international airport after arriving on a flight from London. Her 45-year-old son accompanied her.

"After a search at the airport the narcotics were found in her possession," said a police spokesman. Cyprus law forbids possession of any type of narcotics and does not differentiate between "hard" or "soft" drugs.
